scope: Proposition 6.1 (Localized exponential moment for trajectory failures) of the manuscript “A density-uniform condensate bound for dilute Bose gases” (preprints/A-density-uniform-condensate-bound-for-dilute-Bose-gases-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5dceb5d5d293d6dc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix K as in the cell construction. There exist Dmin, Cv, and κ > 0, depending on the fixed potential and on K, such that the following holds. Fix D ≥ Dmin and 0 < ζ ≤ 1. For sufficiently small ρ > 0 and sufficiently large volume at that density, uniformly for ρ/2 ≤ N/V ≤ 2ρ and 0 < T ≤ ρ2, every nonempty coarse cell union U satisfies log Ecl exp(Jfail U ) ≤  Cv X j≥0 D3 j e−κD2 j + oρ(1)   ρ|U|, Dj = 2j D. (17) The constants Cv, κ do not depend on D or ζ. The term oρ(1) is at fixed v, K, D, ζ and is uniform in the stated particle numbers, volumes, and temperatures.
